predictor: Local Saturday/Sunday indicator minus its full-2025 mean, with DST; no holiday inference, residual demand or hour-specific target lookup
fit: All-year in-sample observed-minus-anchor prices, only matching local interior gas/coal/nuclear offers (>0.001 MW from both bounds, price difference <=0.00001). Regress against existing 15 calendar nuisance columns plus centered weekend; retain only weekend coefficient. Clip response +/-100 EUR/MWh; ridge 168 I; at least 168 matching hours and 24 of each day type.
offers: Same family/zone adjustment on every block; floor final offers at zero. All other offers and all physical inputs unchanged relative to each anchor.
research_filters: Each correction must reduce its anchor full-year price MAE, with daily-demeaned, generation and trade errors no more than 2% worse; 8760 optimal hours, zero emergency <=1e-6 MWh, independent source/native/dual replay. These are experimental safeguards, not acceptance or automatic promotion.
scope: One predetermined correction per anchor, no strength sweep/refit after results. 2025 reconstruction, not independent forecast validation or identified real bids. Previous joint calibration stays a checkpoint. No baseline/browser promotion.
